notes: Text boxes: listStories() has no text-box story and snapshotStory() cannot address one; a text box's paragraphs are main-story blocks (getContent() lists them after the paragraph that draws the box), which is how story=textbox is reached.
suggest_changes (the agent tool) takes main-story operations only; header, footer and note cells come from FolioDocxReviewer.applyDocumentOperationsToStory.
getComments() reads anchors in the body only: a comment on a header, footer or note lists with anchoredText "" and blockId null, so the oracle checks such a comment's text, not its anchor.
getChanges() lists body changes only: acceptChange()/rejectChange() cannot address a change in a header, footer or note; acceptAll()/rejectAll() resolve them.

field, hyperlink and inlineObject are block-level features: no reader exposes their offsets, so an operation counts when it targets a block holding one. noteReference, formatBoundary and surrogateBoundary spans are aimed at by offset (support/targets.ts).
